investigation: Target Add-to-cart request contract from public storefront code
evidenceType: Static public page configuration and shipped JavaScript; no live cart mutation attempted

request.note: These are fields in the public builders, not a minimal validated request. Undefined fields are omitted by JSON.stringify. Shipping-specific defaults, cookies required by the service and response reconciliation remain unverified.

clientFlow: The Add control passes the selected product, quantity and fulfillment into the cart payload builder.
The request builder reads the public carts service URL and application key from page configuration.
It POSTs the JSON payload with credentials included, then updates the client cart state from the response.

repositoryFlow.node: src/target.mjs:addOne clicks the exact Add button and waits for merchant acknowledgement
repositoryFlow.extension: extension/target-shipping/shipping.js performs its gated Add click; the worker tracks acknowledgement

limits: Endpoint visibility does not establish that an anonymous or scripted request will be accepted.
The public application key alone is not proof of a working shopper session.
No live add, cart readback, checkout or order was performed in this discovery.
This does not establish a complete HTTP purchase implementation.
